Are you looking for a logistics position within an innovative high-tech environment? Do you enjoy working in a structured and modern workplace where logistics and technology come together? Then this opportunity as a High-Tech Logistics Operator could be the perfect fit for you. What’s your job about? As a High-Tech Logistics Operator, you play an important role in ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products throughout the organization. Your work directly supports production processes and helps maintain operational efficiency. Your responsibilities include: Packing and preparing products for shipment. Processing and preparing outgoing orders. Transporting materials and goods within the warehouse and production areas. Working with logistics systems such as SAP. Monitoring the flow of goods and reporting discrepancies. Ensuring materials are available on time for production. Contributing to continuous improvements within logistics processes. This role goes beyond traditional warehouse activities. You are an essential link between logistics and production, helping to ensure that operations run efficiently and without interruptions. What skills do you have? A hands-on and proactive attitude. Accuracy and attention to detail. Motivation to learn and develop within a logistics environment. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Good communication skills in English. Previous logistics or warehouse experience is an advantage, but not required. Certificates such as EPT, forklift, or reach truck are considered a plus. What do you get in return? A gross salary of €19.17 per hour, including shift allowance. Travel allowance. A modern, clean, and high-tech working environment. Opportunities for personal development and career growth. A dynamic and motivated international team. Pension scheme participation. Holiday allowance and vacation days in accordance with Dutch regulations. You will join an international high-tech organization specializing in the

development and production of advanced technologies for industries such as industrial automation, energy, and healthcare. The company is known for its innovative culture, modern facilities, and strong focus on quality, collaboration, and employee development. Within this organization, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop new skills, and contribute to cutting-edge technologies used around the world.
